    {"name": "aspect_music", "analytical_usefulness": 0.75, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "rationale": "Near-constant (219 zeros) but a legitimate theme; silent rows correctly zero. Slightly weaker leverage given rarity but still a valid axis."},
    {"name": "aspect_humor", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "rationale": "Humor mention count is a real theme dimension; values look grounded for silent rows (all 0 here)."},
    {"name": "aspect_emotion", "analytical_usefulness": 0.78, "source_groundedness": 0.82, "rationale": "Emotion count is relevant; row 3's emotion=1 (poignant/drama) is a sound reading."},
    {"name": "aspect_special_effects", "analytical_usefulness": 0.7, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "rationale": "Highly sparse (233 zeros) so limited leverage, but a valid theme and correctly zero for silent rows."},
    {"name": "aspect_nostalgia", "analytical_usefulness": 0.78, "source_groundedness": 0.8, "rationale": "Nostalgia is a distinctive theme; row 1's nostalgia=2 ('when I was younger', '12 year-old me') is well grounded."},
    {"name": "dominant_theme", "analytical_usefulness": 0.9, "source_groundedness": 0.75, "rationale": "Single categorical dominant theme is highly useful for group comparison. Mostly derivable but somewhat redundant with aspect counts, and row 2 labelling 'acting' as dominant is arguable."},
    {"name": "positive_word_count", "analytical_usefulness": 0.6, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "rationale": "Somewhat generic sentiment lexicon count, but gives a magnitude axis. Values plausible against text."},
    {"name": "negative_word_count", "analytical_usefulness": 0.6, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "rationale": "Generic but usable; row 2's high negative count matches strongly negative text."},
    {"name": "sentiment_word_ratio", "analytical_usefulness": 0.55, "source_groundedness": 0.75, "rationale": "Derived restatement of the two word counts, adding modest leverage. Ratio=0 when zero words is a convention but slightly ambiguous."},
    {"name": "sarcasm_signal", "analytical_usefulness": 0.5, "source_groundedness": 0.6, "rationale": "Potentially interesting for theme/tone but near-constant (248 zeros) and sarcasm detection is unreliable; row 2 flag is defensible but low-confidence inference."},
    {"name": "review_length_words", "analytical_usefulness": 0.35, "source_groundedness": 0.95, "rationale": "Raw token count is generic and adds little thematic leverage for this query, though accurately derived from text."}
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.75,
  "source_groundedness": 0.82,
  "rationale": "The aspect_* mention counts and dominant_theme directly serve the query of comparing review themes across sentiment groups, offering genuine grouping and comparison axes; they are mostly sound readings of the source text with reasonable zeros for silent rows. Sentiment word counts and their ratio add modest magnitude signal, while review_length_words and sarcasm_signal are the weakest—generic or near-constant—though still well grounded. Groundedness is generally high across sampled rows with only minor over-confident category calls (e.g., dominant_theme on strongly negative reviews)."
}
